title: Nothing special
text: I have gotten lots of subscription boxes over the last 5 years so getting something for my two crazy cats seemed like a good idea. Shipping was very prompt. The box was packaged well. Presentation was thought out with a card enclosed to explain items and dollar value. So far, so good.  But the items in the box were not that great. My cats weren’t impressed and spent little time with the toys. Overall monetary value of the box was nominal. For me, I would rather just buy a couple new toys from various stores or online dealers. One box was sufficient to get an idea of future offerings. I canceled
label: neutral
